versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00154, SRS_Rte_00158 If data emulation with SW support is enabled, the RTE shall guarantee that all shared ParameterDataPrototype s marked with same property swAddrMethod of an AUTOSAR SWC type are allocated consecutively (for the ordering see parameter RteComponentTypeParameterGroup ). Together they build a separate Parame- terElementGroup .
